info.name: GAISe API
info.description:
GAISe (Generative AI Service) exposes one provider-neutral contract over OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, Ollama, and ElevenLabs (text-to-speech).

Routes: POST /v1/instruct, POST /v1/instruct/stream (SSE), POST /v1/embeddings, GET /v1/models, GET /v1/models/{provider}::{id}, POST /v1/speech, POST /v1/speech/stream (SSE), POST /v1/speech/audio (raw audio), GET /v1/live (WebSocket; not representable here).

Set the collection variables (base_url and one model per vendor) and configure the server with the provider credentials described in wiki/api.md#configuration. Full reference: wiki/README.md.

item.name: Models
item.description: Model discovery across every configured provider. Semantics: wiki/capabilities.md#model-discovery; catalog: wiki/models.md.

request.description: Fans out to every configured provider; per-provider failures are reported in `errors`, never dropped.
operation is one of instruct, instruct_stream, embeddings, live.
Models GAISe can drive through GET /v1/live (OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live).
Provider + operation filter.
One extra call per installed tag; returns capabilities and context length.
Attaches the provider's native model object as `raw`.

Every registry entry's documented `context_window`, `max_output_tokens`, `max_input_tokens`, `embedding_dimensions`, and `max_input_characters`, served from the bundled registry without contacting any provider.
Filters apply to the registry rows; `operation` accepts instruct, instruct_stream, embeddings, speech, live.
Single enriched record; 404 if the provider does not list it, 400 without the :: separator.
Cross-region profiles inherit the foundation model's capabilities.
Demonstrates query validation.

item.name: Instruct
item.description: Provider-neutral request shapes. Swap the model variable to route anywhere. Wire reference: wiki/api.md#post-v1instruct.

request.description: Adapters flatten nested parts while preserving order.
Audio input is native on Gemini/Vertex, OpenAI audio models, and Bedrock where permitted; Anthropic and Ollama return an explicit unsupported marker.
Returned bytes arrive as ordinary image content objects.
cache_key maps to prompt_cache_key on OpenAI; Anthropic uses automatic ephemeral cache control instead.
Response is text/event-stream.
connection.api_url / api_key / region / service_account override the server configuration for this call only. Keys are redacted in server logs.

item.name: Embeddings
item.description: Text embeddings. task (document|query|classification|clustering|similarity|code_query|fact_verification|question_answering, aliases such as search_query, or a vendor value passed through), dimensions, and normalize are resolved per model from the registry profile: wire task fields, prompt instructions, local-model prefixes, dimension snapping, and local normalization. wiki/embeddings.md#how-a-request-is-resolved

request.description: Embed corpus text with task=document; dimensions requests Matryoshka truncation where the model supports it.
Embed the query side with task=query — Gemini/Vertex taskType and Cohere input_type differ between documents and queries.

item.name: Local model query (prefix applied from task)

request.description: On Ollama tags with a documented convention (nomic-embed-text, mxbai-embed-large, qwen3-embedding, snowflake-arctic-embed2, embeddinggemma) GAISe prepends the query prefix or instruction itself; "search_query" is an alias of "query".
task maps to Cohere input_type; normalize requests unit-length vectors (Titan V2 natively, others locally).
text-embedding-3-* accept dimensions; ada-002 does not (ignored).

item.name: Speech
item.description: Text-to-speech via ElevenLabs. Set elevenlabs_voice_id from GET /v2/voices on your account (default voices are account-gated). Reference: wiki/api.md#post-v1speech, wiki/vendor-elevenlabs.md.

request.description: Returns GaiseSpeechResponse: audio byte array, format, sample_rate, usage.

body.raw:
{
  "model": "{{elevenlabs_model}}",
  "voice": "{{elevenlabs_voice_id}}",
  "input": "Welcome to GAISe. The build is green.",
  "format": "audio/pcm",
  "sample_rate": 24000,
  "language": "en",
  "voice_settings": {
    "stability": 0.5,
    "similarity": 0.75,
    "speed": 1.0
  },
  "include_alignment": true
}

request.description: Adds character timing (alignment.characters/start_seconds/end_seconds).
Omit format for mp3_44100_128.

body.raw:
{
  "model": "{{elevenlabs_model}}",
  "voice": "{{elevenlabs_voice_id}}",
  "input": "Welcome to GAISe. The build is green.",
  "format": "audio/pcm",
  "sample_rate": 24000,
  "language": "en",
  "voice_settings": {
    "stability": 0.5,
    "similarity": 0.75,
    "speed": 1.0
  },
  "include_alignment": true
}

request.description: text/event-stream of audio, alignment, and usage chunks.
Raw chunked audio body; Content-Type and X-Gaise-Sample-Rate headers. Save the response to a file or pipe to a player.
v3 takes delivery hints as audio tags in the text; max 5,000 characters.
GET /v1/models reports speech + live operations per model.
Every provider's speech-capable models.

item.name: Vendors
item.description: The same request set for each provider. Requires the matching credentials on the server.

item.name: OpenAI
item.description: Every route exercised against OpenAI. Model IDs come from collection variables. Mapping details: wiki/vendor-openai.md

request.description: Plain text instruct via OpenAI. See wiki/vendor-openai.md.
Multi-turn conversation with a system instruction. Fixed-sampling families drop temperature automatically.
Byte arrays are placeholders. Image support depends on the model; see wiki/capabilities.md#modalities-by-provider.
UTF-8 text files become tagged text on providers without native documents; PDFs are native on Anthropic, Gemini, Vertex, and Bedrock.
Reasoning controls map per provider (reasoning_effort, adaptive thinking, thinkingLevel/thinkingBudget, think). Accepted values per model are in wiki/models.md.
Expect an assistant message with tool_calls. Copy id/name into the next request.
Replace call-123 with the id from the previous response. tool_name is required for Gemini/Vertex.
Server-Sent Events; each data: line is a GaiseInstructStreamResponse (text, content, tool_call, usage).
Text embeddings. Usage is present only when the provider reports it.
GET /v1/models for OpenAI only; errors propagate as HTTP 500.
